messages.subject: GoogleVis Plots
parts:
Hi,

I have a dataset containing the list of Employees, their IDs and their expenditures
I am creating a googlevisLineChart but I need the variables for the y-axes and x-axes to be given by the user(maybe on the Sidebar panel or anywhere else). Also, I need a selectBox to select a particular Employee for which the plotting should happen. So, the user gets to choose the Employee, the y-axis variables and the x-axis variable. 
NOTE: The Employees and the y-axes variables could be multiple selections.

I am not able to get the output correctly on the page. Kindly advise and tell me where am I doing wrong.
I have attached the dataset that I am using.

Also, below are my UI.R and server.R codes:

ui.R
shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(
  
  # Application title
  headerPanel("Shiny Project-1"), 
  
  
  # Sidebar with controls to select the variable plot against mpg and to specify whether outliers 
  # should be included
  sidebarPanel(
    # Panel for File Input
    fileInput('file1', 'Choose a CSV file', 
              accept=c('text/csv', 'text/comma-separated-values,text/plain')), 
    # Conditional Panel when the Benford Analysis tab is selected
    conditionalPanel(
      condition = "input.tabSet == 'Benford Analysis'", 
      uiOutput("benfordVars")), 
    # Conditional Panel when the GG Plots tab is selected
    conditionalPanel(
      condition = "input.tabSet == 'GG Plots'", 
      uiOutput("plotsVar")), 
    # Conditional Panel when the GVis Plots tab is selected
    conditionalPanel(
      condition = "input.tabSet == 'GVis Plots'", 
      uiOutput("gvisPanel"))
  ), 
  
  mainPanel(
    tabsetPanel(id="tabSet", 
                tabPanel("Data", htmlOutput("contents")), 
                tabPanel("Benford Analysis", uiOutput("benford")), 
                tabPanel("GG Plots", plotOutput("ggplots")), 
               tabPanel("GVis Plots", plotOutput("gvisplots"))
    )
  )
))

server.R
# Define Server for the Outlier Detection Shiny Application
shinyServer(function(input, output) {
  
  # Load the required Data
  dataset <- reactive({
    inFile <- input$file1
    if (is.null(inFile))
      return(NULL)
    read.csv(file=inFile$datapath, header=TRUE, sep=",")
  })
  #   Read the Data File
  output$contents <- renderGvis({
    gvisTable(dataset(),options=list(showRowNumber=TRUE,pageable=TRUE,width=800, height=500),)
#     dataset()
  })
# Display Side-bar panel for GGPlots & GoogleVis Plot tab for selection of axis variables
output$gvisPanel <- renderUI({
  # Create the X-axis and Y-axis Variables
  vars <- names(dataset())
  empOptions <- unique(dataset()[,1])
  inputList <- c(selectInput(inputId="empSel", label = "Select Employee:", 
                             choices = empOptions), 
                 checkboxGroupInput(inputId="variableY", label = "Select Y-axis Variable(s):", 
                                    choices = vars), 
                 checkboxGroupInput(inputId="variableX", label = "Select X-axis Variable(s):", 
                                    choices = vars))
  return(inputList)
})

# Display Google Vis Plots
library(googleVis)
#   output$gvisplots <- renderGvis({
output$gvisplots <- renderPlot({
  datasubset <- subset(dataset(), select = c(names(dataset())[1], input$variableX))
  datasubset <- dataset()[dataset()$names(dataset())[1] %in% input$empSel, ]
  for(i in 1:length(input$varY)) {
    for(j in 1:length(dataset())) {
      if(names(varY)[i]==names(dataset())[j]) {
        datasubset <- data.frame(cbind(datasubset,dataset()[,j]), stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
      }
    }
  }
  #     gvisLineChart(dataset(),options=list(gvis.editor='Edit Plot', width=1280, height=550))
  # Finding the Variables
  # Plotting the graphs using googleVis package
  editor <- gvisLineChart(datasubset,options=list(gvis.editor='Edit Plot', width=1280))
  p <- plot(editor)
  return(p)
})

Also, it will be great if you could give me a code to make the Employee selection text-box also a generic one i.e. User selects for what category does he want to plot and then another selectbox opens up for him to give multiple selections in that category.

Thanks in advance.
